summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Qatar commanding a commanding 98-point lead over Max Verstappen, with Mercedes dominating early practice as the champion sets the pace ahead of team-mate George Russell. The tire allocation—capped at 27 laps per set—will force aggressive strategy calls that could shake up grid positions and pit-stop windows throughout the weekend. Victory for Antonelli would move Mercedes within touching distance of a constructors' championship crown, while a Verstappen or Ferrari surge could reshape the final-round dynamics heading to Abu Dhabi.
